# Jeremiah 39 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 39:2 (overlap: 7%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | In-the-eleventh year of-Zedekiah, in-the-fourth month, on-the-ninth of-the-month, the-city was-breached. |
| LOGOS | In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, a breach was made in the city. |
| PNEUMA | On July 18 of the eleventh year of Zedekiah's reign, the Babylonians finally broke through the city wall. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
